extracted.name: Berry Overnight Oats
extracted.description: Layer milk-soaked oats with Greek yogurt, chia seeds, and mixed fruit and berries, then refrigerate overnight for this berry overnight oats recipe.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup Quaker® Oats (Quick or Old Fashioned, uncooked)
1 cup fresh mixed berries and fruit
instruction_lines: Add oats to the container of choice; pour in milk.
Layer in Greek yogurt, chia seeds, and mixed berries and fruit.
